fact: TechCabal reports that Turbine, based in Port Louis, has accelerated more than 150 startups since 2016, running pre-incubation, one-year incubation and six-month acceleration phases for its cohorts.

CAJ News reports Mauritius inaugurated an AI Innovation Lab in Ebene Cybercity with STEMpower, with a 24-computer AI training lab and an electronics lab open to students, technology entrepreneurs, experts and civil society, and no startup programme or cohort stated.
The article says Mauritius's innovation initiatives include fab labs and an AI Tech Park, oriented towards innovation actors, citing the Blueprint for Mauritius 2025.

MRIC says its government-initiated National SME Incubator Scheme, operational since December 2017, works with 6 accredited private-sector incubators running pre-incubation, incubation and acceleration phases, with 50 start-ups produced and 65 ongoing projects as of October 2024.
